blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Poplar was little changed, 28 in June and 28 in October (+0.0%), and 9 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.8% of Abbotsford’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Poplar?
Poplar also had 26 condos and townhomes listed and 7 sold in October, against 28 houses listed. The Poplar condos and townhomes page has those figures.

items.t: Poplar condos and townhomes for sale

Poplar is the south-west Abbotsford house area below Highway 1, around Clearbrook Road, Peardonville Road and Marshall Road. Its southern streets — King Road and Huntingdon Road — run toward the United States border at the Sumas–Huntingdon crossing on Highway 11.
The City's neighbourhood plans page is the index for any plan covering a Poplar street.
South Poplar Traditional Elementary, at 32746 Huntingdon Road, anchors the south end of the area and carries "Poplar" in its name.
The Abbotsford School of Integrated Arts (ASIA) North Poplar campus, at 32041 Marshall Road, sits at the north end of Poplar.
Poplar's detached stock mixes suburban houses near Clearbrook Road with rural houses and small acreages toward King Road and Huntingdon Road.
Houses on the north side of Poplar sit near the Marshall Road corridor; the ASIA North Poplar campus address, 32041 Marshall Road, marks that built-up northern edge.

blocks.text: Poplar Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A Poplar house near the airport flight paths can face federal height limits. Poplar is east of Abbotsford International Airport (YXX); where a lot falls inside the Airport Zoning Regulation area on City drawing M-500, height limits and NAV CANADA / Transport Canada approvals apply before a City permit.

blocks.text: Poplar Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: King Traditional Elementary, at 28776 King Road, is the other traditional elementary serving the Poplar side, on King Road itself.
Clearbrook Elementary, at 3614 Clearbrook Road, serves the Clearbrook Road corridor at Poplar's west edge.
Poplar houses pay the same City of Abbotsford tax bylaw as the rest of the city — Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3643-2025 sets the 2025 rates per $1,000 of taxable value.

The Poplar-specific cost difference is the water district, not the tax rate. Houses in the Clearbrook Waterworks District are billed quarterly for sewer; other Abbotsford houses are billed bi-monthly for water and sewer.
Route 3 is the bus named for Poplar's corridor: Clearbrook / Huntingdon, in BC Transit's Central Fraser Valley route list.
Highway 11 (Sumas Way) at Poplar's east side runs south to the Sumas–Huntingdon United States border crossing and north to Highway 1.
Clearbrook Road (Highway 1 Exit 87) is Poplar's freeway exit, linking Marshall Road and Peardonville Road streets to the rest of Abbotsford.

blocks.text: Poplar Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the airport zoning overlay before any addition on a west Poplar lot. The City's YXX guidelines tie height to the Airport Zoning Regulations and drawing M-500.
Check ALR status before assuming a south Poplar acreage can be split or gain a second house.
Check wells and septic on rural Poplar lots outside the urban boundary, using the Province's well records.
Check the parcel on City WebMap for the lot's own layers; the map does not replace a title search.

blocks.text: Poplar home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Poplar with a median price of $925,000 (the middle half sold between $869,250 and $1,048,250), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $408 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 7,327 square feet.

A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Poplar?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 28 houses listed in Poplar. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Poplar a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Poplar had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Poplar from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Poplar over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Poplar?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Is a South Poplar house in the flood area?
faq.a: South Poplar sits on higher ground than Sumas Prairie, but the lot still needs its own check. The City's flood pages focus on the Sumas and Matsqui prairie dike areas east and north of Poplar, so do not assume a Huntingdon Road lot carries the prairie flood covenant — check the parcel on the City WebMap and ask what is on title.

faq.q: Which water bill will a Poplar house get?
faq.a: It depends which side of the Clearbrook Waterworks District line the house is on. Poplar's Clearbrook Road streets are where that district boundary matters, so confirm the billing district for the exact address at closing.

faq.q: Can I build taller or add a unit near the airport side of Poplar?
faq.a: Height is capped first by the federal airport rules, before City zoning. Get the lot checked against drawing M-500 before designing an addition.

faq.q: What did houses in Poplar sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Poplar between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $925,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Poplar?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
